taxes.tax: Other notable taxes (federal vs regional income-tax powers (regional proclamations mirror the federal one); provision not located by keyword in the reachable text)
taxes.statute: Federal Income Tax Proclamation No. 979/2016 as amended by Proclamation No. 1395/2025
taxes.oecdGuide: OECD Interpretative Guide (Revenue Statistics 2026, Annex A; R4/fetch/gap/oecd_guide.txt) §28 (receipts classified by base: income taxes under 1000), §97 and §104 (a State's tax is attributed to the State that imposes it and sets its rate; the heading does not change)
taxes.why: The registry row is a note on the division of income-tax powers, not a levy: the States levy the same income taxes on employees of the State and of private enterprises, on individual traders, on rental income from private houses and on farmers (FDRE Constitution 1995 art. 97 (1), (3), (4), (6); lexifina/ethiopia-law, constitution/art-097.md), under regional proclamations that reproduce the federal schedules of Proclamation 979/2016 (as amended by 1395/2025). Those payments are the 1100/1200 taxes already modelled (P2 CIT, P3 Schedules B-D, 1.x PIT); only their attribution to the State level differs. No separate payment remains to model.
